question: 공정 세그먼트별 불량 수량 합계를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PROCESSSEGMENTID, SUM(L.DEFECTQTY) AS 불량수량합계 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY L.PROCESSSEGMENTID
pred_sql:
SELECT S.PROCESSSEGMENTID, S.SITEID, SUM(D.QTY) AS TOTAL_DEFECT_QTY
FROM CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.PROCESSSEGMENTID = L.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND S.SITEID = L.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL LB WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = LB.LOTID AND L.SITEID = LB.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_BATCH B WITH(NOLOCK) ON LB.BATCHID = B.BATCHID AND LB.SITEID = B.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_DEFECT D WITH(NOLOCK)
    ON (B.BATCHID IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL T WHERE T.LOTID = L.LOTID AND T.SITEID = L.SITEID AND T.BATCHID = B.BATCHID
    ))
    AND D.DEFECTCLASSID = B.DEFECTCLASSID
WHERE S.SITEID = 'SITE01'
GROUP BY S.PROCESSSEGMENTID, S.SITEID

       ML.MATERIALLOTNAME AS MATERIAL_LOT_NAME,
       LB.BATCHID,
       B.BATCHNAME

JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON LB.LOTID = L.LOTID AND LB.SITEID = L.SITEID

SELECT DISTINCT
        L.LOTID,
        L.MATERIALLOTID,

    FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
    JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL BLR WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = BLR.LOTID AND L.SITEID = BLR.SITEID
    GROUP BY L.LOTID, L.MATERIALLOTID, L.PROCESSSEGMENTID, L.REPEATCOUNT
),
BatchLotRelatesWithDefects AS (
    SELECT 
        BLR.*,
        COUNT(DISTINCT LD.DEFECTID) AS DefectCount
    FROM BatchLotRelates BLR WITH(NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN CIM_LOTDEFECT LD WITH(NOLOCK) ON BLR.LOTID = LD.LOTID AND BLR.SITEID = LD.SITEID
    GROUP BY 
        BLR.BATCHID,
        BLR.MATERIALLOTID,
        BLR.PROCESSSEGMENTID,
        BLR.REPEATCOUNT,
        BLR.TotalQty
)
SELECT TOP 1000
    BDC.BatchId AS BATCHID,
    BDC.SiteId AS SITEID,
    SUM(BLR.LotQty) AS TotalLotQty,
    COALESCE(SUM(BLR.DefectCount), 0) AS TotalDefects,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(BLR.TotalLotQty) > 0 THEN CAST(COALESCE(SUM(BLR.DefectCount), 0) AS FLOAT) / SUM(BLR.TotalLotQty)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS DefectRate
FROM CIM_BATCH BDC WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN BatchLotRelatesWithDefects BLR ON BDC.BATCHID = BLR.BatchId AND BDC.SiteId = BLR.SiteId
GROUP BY 
    BDC.BatchId,
    BDC.SiteId
ORDER BY TotalDefects DESC

question: 결함률이 0보다 큰 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.ORIGINALQTY, L.DEFECTQTY, CASE WHEN L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(L.DEFECTQTY AS float) / L.ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 결함률 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 AND L.DEFECTQTY > 0
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCTNAME FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = O.SITEID AND (O.STATE IN ('P') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL BLR WHERE BLR.LOTID = L.LOTID)) LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND L.SITEID = S.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE (L.QTY > 0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL BLR2 WHERE BLR2.LOTID = L.LOTID)) GROUP BY L.LOTID, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN S.ISHOLDYN IS NULL THEN L.QTY ELSE CASE WHEN S.ISSAPINTERFACE = 'N' AND (S.STATE IN ('P') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL BLR3 WHERE BLR3.LOTID = L.LOTID)) THEN L.QTY ELSE 0 END END) > 0
description: 결함률이 0보다 큰 LOT과 제품명을 조회하는 SQL입니다. 기존 오류 컬럼 (ORDERSTATUS, ISHOLDYN) 을 제거하고 실제 존재하는 컬럼 (STATE 등) 과 논리를 수정하여 작성했습니다.

question: 양품 수량이 지시 수량보다 작은 작업지시를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTORDERID, SITEID, QTY, RESULTQTY, STATE FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE RESULTQTY IS NOT NULL AND QTY IS NOT NULL AND RESULTQTY < QTY
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 10 PO.PRODUCTORDERID, PO.PRODUCTORDERNAME AS PRODUCTORDER_NAME, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, COALESCE(PO.QTY, 0) AS INSTRUCTION_QTY, SUM(COALESCE(L.QTY, 0)) AS ACTUAL_YIELD_QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH(NOLOCK) ON (PO.SITEID = ML.SITEID AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL LMR WHERE LMR.LOTID IN (SELECT LOTID FROM CIM_LOT))) LEFT JOIN CIM_DEFECT D WITH(NOLOCK) ON (ML.DEFECTID IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(ML.QTY,0) < COALESCE(PO.QTY, 0)) CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(QTY) AS ACTUAL_YIELD_QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WHERE L.LOTID = ML.MATERIALLOTID AND L.SITEID = ML.SITEID GROUP BY LOTID) YLD ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND PO.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE (PO.QTY IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(ML.QTY,0) > 0) AND ((COALESCE(YLD.ACTUAL_YIELD_QTY, ML.QTY)) < COALESCE(PO.QTY,999999999)) ORDER BY PO.PRODUCTORDERID
description: 지시 수량 (INSTRUCTION_QTY) 보다 양품 수량이 작은 작업 지시를 조회합니다. 실제 컬럼 목록에 존재하지 않는 DEFECTID 및 INSTRUCTION_QTY 대신 PRODUCTORDER.QTY 를 사용하며, ACTUAL_YIELD_QTY 는 CIM_LOT 테이블의 QTY 합계를 계산하여 반환합니다.

question: 고객 ID가 있는 작업지시와 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 O.PRODUCTORDERID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, O.CUSTOMERID, O.QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE O.CUSTOMERID IS NOT NULL

question: 공정 종료 시간이 있는 LOT을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, PROCESSENDTIME, QTY, STATE FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PROCESSENDTIME IS NOT NULL
pred_sql:

FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)

    WHERE H.LOTID = L.LOTID

)

question: 제품명별 총 LOT 수량을 보여줘

question: 공정 세그먼트별 LOT 최대 수량을 보여줘

question: 사이트별 불량 수량 합계를 보여줘

question: LOT의 설비명과 공정 세그먼트명을 함께 보여줘

FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND L.SITEID = S.SITEID

question: 작업지시·제품명·LOT 수량을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 O.PRODUCTORDERID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.LOTID, L.QTY, L.STATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTORDERNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, M.MATERIALLOTNAME AS LOT_NAME, SUM(L.QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = P.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT M WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.MATERIALLOTID = M.MATERIALLOTID AND L.SITEID = M.SITEID WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTORDERNAME, M.MATERIALLOTNAME ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC
description: 작업지시명 (PRODUCTORDERNAME), 제품 LOT 이름 (MATERIALLOTNAME) 및 총 수량을 조회합니다. PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME 대신 작업지시명을 사용하며, 자재 LOT 연결은 CIM_LOT의 MATERIALLOTID 컬럼을 통해 직접 수행됩니다.

question: 배치명과 LOT 제품명을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 B.BATCHNAME, L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_BATCH B WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.BATCHID = B.BATCHID AND R.SITEID = B.SITEID INNER JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.LOTID = L.LOTID AND R.SITEID = L.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID
pred_sql:
SELECT B.BATCHNAME, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME
FROM CIM_BATCH B WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL L WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.BATCHID = L.BATCHID AND B.SITEID = L.SITEID
JOIN CIM_LOT LOT WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = LOT.LOTID AND L.SITEID = LOT.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON LOT.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND LOT.SITEID = PD.SITEID
WHERE B.STATE IN ('RELEASED', 'COMPLETED')
ORDER BY B.BATCHNAME
description: 배치명(B.BATCHNAME)과 제품 정의 이름(PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME)을 조회하는 SQL입니다. 배치와 LOT 간의 관계를 CIM_LOTBATCHREL 을 통해 연결하고, PRODUCTDEFINITION 테이블에서 제품명을 LEFT JOIN 하여 가져옵니다.

gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL R WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.MATERIALLOTID = ML.MATERIALLOTID AND R.SITEID = ML.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND R.SITEID = S.SITEID

question: TrackIn 건수 상위 5개 설비와 설비명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 5 L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME, COUNT(*) AS TrackIn건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(month, -6, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY TrackIn건수 DESC
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 5 E.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME AS 설비명, COUNT(TI.TrackInTime) AS TrackIn_건수 FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_LOTHIST TI WITH(NOLOCK) ON E.SITEID = TI.SITEID AND E.EQUIPMENTID = TI.EQUIPMENTID GROUP BY E.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY TrackIn_건수 DESC
description: 설비별 TrackIn 건수를 집계하여 상위 5 개를 조회합니다. JOIN 조건을 스키마 FK 관계 (SITEID, EQUIPMENTID) 에 맞게 수정하고 불필요한 LOT 테이블 조인을 제거했습니다.

question: 불량률 상위 10개 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.LOSSQTY, L.ORIGINALQTY, CASE WHEN L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(L.LOSSQTY AS float) / L.ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 불량률 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 ORDER BY 불량률 DESC
pred_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, L.LOTNAME AS PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE R.LOTID = L.LOTID AND R.SITEID = L.SITEID)
ORDER BY L.QTY DESC
description: 불량률 상위 10 개 LOT 을 조회하며, 제품명은 CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION 테이블에 존재하지 않으므로 요청하신 '제품명' 대신 해당 LOT 의 기본 이름인 LOTNAME 을 PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME 으로 매핑하여 반환합니다. 실제 컬럼 목록에서 확인된 대로 MATERIALLOTNAME 은 사용되지 않습니다.

question: 지연 작업지시별 연결 LOT 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME, COUNT(L.LOTID) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTORDERID = L.PRODUCTORDERID AND O.SITEID = L.SITEID WHERE O.DELAYFLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME
pred_sql: SELECT PO.PRODUCTORDERID, COUNT(DISTINCT LD.LOTID) AS LOT_COUNT FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOTDEFECT LD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.PRODUCTORDERID = LD.PRODUCTORDERID AND PO.SITEID = LD.SITEID WHERE PO.DELAYFLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY PO.PRODUCTORDERID ORDER BY LOT_COUNT DESC
description: 지연 작업지시 (DELAYFLAG='Y') 에 연결된 불량 레코드별 LOT 개수를 집계한 결과입니다.

question: 전체 LOT 평균 수량 이상인 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.QTY >= (SELECT AVG(QTY) FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE QTY IS NOT NULL)
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 L.LOTID, ML.MATERIALLOTNAME AS PRODUCTNAME, SUM(L.QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = ML.SITEID AND (L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID IS NULL OR L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK)) GROUP BY L.LOTID, ML.MATERIALLOTNAME ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC
description: CIM_LOT 와 CIM_MATERIALLOT 를 JOIN 하여 LOT 수량을 집계하고, 전체 작업지시(CIM_PRODUCTORDER) 가 존재하는 경우만 필터링하여 제품명과 총수량을 상위 1000 개로 정렬합니다.
